title: Two Sum
problem: Return indices of two numbers whose sum equals target.
approach: Store previously seen values in a map and look up the complement.

title: Valid Anagram
problem: Check whether two lowercase English-letter strings have the same character counts.
approach: Count characters in a fixed-size array.

title: Contains Duplicate
problem: Determine whether any value occurs more than once.
approach: Insert into a set; a failed insertion reveals a duplicate.

title: Group Anagrams
problem: Group strings that contain the same letters with the same frequencies.
approach: Use a sorted character sequence as a canonical key.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
problem: Return the k numbers with the highest occurrence counts.
approach: Count frequencies and maintain a min-heap of size k.

title: Product of Array Except Self
problem: Compute each index’s product of all other values without division.
approach: Multiply prefix products and then suffix products.

title: Valid Palindrome
problem: Ignore punctuation and case while testing whether a string reads the same backward.
example: "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama" → true
approach: Move two pointers inward, skipping non-alphanumeric characters.

title: 3Sum
problem: Find unique triples of numbers summing to zero.
approach: Sort; fix one element and sweep the remaining pair.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problem: Maximize profit from one buy followed by one sell.
approach: Track the lowest price seen and best profit so far.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problem: Find the maximum length of a substring with no repeated characters.
approach: Track last seen index and advance the left boundary.

title: Valid Parentheses
problem: Determine whether bracket characters are correctly nested and closed.
approach: Push expected closing brackets and match them on encounter.

title: Binary Search
problem: Find target in a sorted ascending array; return -1 if absent.
approach: Halve the remaining search range each step.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problem: Find a target in a distinct-value sorted array rotated at a pivot.
approach: At each step identify the sorted half and discard the other.

title: Maximum Subarray
problem: Find the largest sum of any nonempty contiguous subarray.
approach: Kadane’s algorithm chooses to extend or restart the current subarray.

title: Climbing Stairs
problem: Count ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps at a time.
approach: Each count equals the sum of the preceding two counts.

title: Coin Change
problem: Find the fewest coins needed for an amount, with unlimited coins of each denomination.
approach: Bottom-up DP stores minimum coins for every reachable amount.

title: Number of Islands
problem: Count connected groups of land cells in a 2D grid (4-directional adjacency).
approach: Flood-fill each unvisited land cell using an explicit stack.

title: Merge Intervals
problem: Merge all overlapping closed intervals.
approach: Sort by start and merge when the next interval overlaps.

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problem: Return the kth largest value (including duplicates).
approach: Keep a min-heap with at most k elements.

title: House Robber
problem: Maximize money from nonadjacent houses.
approach: At each house, choose between skipping it or adding it to the best two houses back.
